narrative: The June 29 arXiv batch elevates how agents are composed and orchestrated to a first-order engineering concern rather than an afterthought, which is the precondition for orchestration-specific benchmarks to exist at all. Once orchestration is a measured object, latency becomes an obvious axis to standardize and disclose.
remaining_gap: The papers frame composition and self-evolution, not standardized latency reporting, so no benchmark has actually added a latency-disclosure column yet.
